title: Super Mario RPG: Legend of the Seven Stars - Transition Between Smithy Forms
description: A background you see briefly before landing in the final area where you fight Smithy (who likes transforming.) This is technically the same background used for your battles against Clerk, Manager, Director, Factory Chief, Gunyolk and Smithy in his first form except the factory floor you stand on is blocking most of it during those fights and also the background is in another arrangement altogether in those fights. Uses all of palette 3.
